  <section id="features" aria-labelledby="features-title">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="section-head reveal">
        <h2 id="features-title">Key Features of the Hailuo 2.3 Model</h2>
        <p>The Hailuo 2.3 model is tuned for smooth video, stable styles, and practical creator workflows — including a fast variant for quicker I2V generation.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="bento">
        <article class="bento-card reveal">
          <div class="bento-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="video" class="lucide lucide-video"><path d="m16 13 5.223 3.482a.5.5 0 0 0 .777-.416V7.87a.5.5 0 0 0-.752-.432L16 10.5"></path><rect x="2" y="6" width="14" height="12" rx="2"></rect></svg></div>
          <h3>Multi-modal Video Generation (T2V &amp; I2V)</h3>
          <p>Generate AI videos from a <strong>text description (T2V)</strong> or from a <strong>single image (I2V)</strong> with the Hailuo 2.3 model.</p>
          <div class="modality-chips" aria-hidden="true">
            <span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="type" class="lucide lucide-type"><polyline points="4 7 4 4 20 4 20 7"></polyline><line x1="9" x2="15" y1="20" y2="20"></line><line x1="12" x2="12" y1="4" y2="20"></line></svg>T2V</span>
            <span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="image" class="lucide lucide-image"><rect width="18" height="18" x="3" y="3" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><circle cx="9" cy="9" r="2"></circle><path d="m21 15-3.086-3.086a2 2 0 0 0-2.828 0L6 21"></path></svg>I2V</span>
          </div>
        </article>
        <article class="bento-card reveal">
          <div class="bento-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="scan-face" class="lucide lucide-scan-face"><path d="M3 7V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2"></path><path d="M17 3h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"></path><path d="M21 17v2a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-2"></path><path d="M7 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-2"></path><path d="M8 14s1.5 2 4 2 4-2 4-2"></path><path d="M9 9h.01"></path><path d="M15 9h.01"></path></svg></div>

          <p>Create more natural movement and richer character emotion, including improved <strong>facial micro-expressions</strong> for close-up scenes.</p>
          <div class="modality-chips" aria-hidden="true">
            <span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="scan-face" class="lucide lucide-scan-face"><path d="M3 7V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2"></path><path d="M17 3h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"></path><path d="M21 17v2a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-2"></path><path d="M7 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-2"></path><path d="M8 14s1.5 2 4 2 4-2 4-2"></path><path d="M9 9h.01"></path><path d="M15 9h.01"></path></svg>Micro-expressions</span>
            <span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="move" class="lucide lucide-move"><path d="M12 2v20"></path><path d="m15 19-3 3-3-3"></path><path d="m19 9 3 3-3 3"></path><path d="M2 12h20"></path><path d="m5 9-3 3 3 3"></path><path d="m9 5 3-3 3 3"></path></svg>Natural motion</span>

        </article>

        <article class="bento-card reveal">
          <div class="bento-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="zap" class="lucide lucide-zap"><path d="M4 14a1 1 0 0 1-.78-1.63l9.9-10.2a.5.5 0 0 1 .86.46l-1.92 6.02A1 1 0 0 0 13 10h7a1 1 0 0 1 .78 1.63l-9.9 10.2a.5.5 0 0 1-.86-.46l1.92-6.02A1 1 0 0 0 11 14z"></path></svg></div>

  <section id="how-to" aria-labelledby="howto-title">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="section-head reveal">
        <h2 id="howto-title">How to Generate AI Video with the Hailuo 2.3 Model</h2>
        <p>A simple four-step workflow: describe, pick the Hailuo 2.3 model, generate and refine, then export. Every screenshot below is the real Hailuo AI editor, switched to Hailuo 2.3.</p>
      </div>
      <ol class="stepper">
        <li class="step reveal">
          <figure class="step-media">
            <span class="chrome" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i><b>hailuoai.video/create/image-to-video</b><span class="chrome-tag"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="badge-check" class="lucide lucide-badge-check"><path d="M3.85 8.62a4 4 0 0 1 4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 6.74 0 4 4 0 0 1 4.78 4.78 4 4 0 0 1 0 6.74 4 4 0 0 1-4.77 4.78 4 4 0 0 1-6.75 0 4 4 0 0 1-4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 0-6.76Z"></path><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"></path></svg>Real Hailuo AI editor</span></span>
            <span class="shot">
              <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Hailuo AI editor in Start/End Frame mode with the Hailuo 2.3 model selected, showing frame upload slots and the prompt field" width="688" height="430" loading="lazy" decoding="async">
            </span>
          </figure>
          <div class="step-body">
            <div class="step-head"><span class="step-dot" aria-hidden="true">1</span><h3>Describe Your Scene</h3></div>
            <p>Write a detailed prompt (or upload a <strong>start frame</strong>) to set the subject, style, and motion you want. Hailuo 2.3 runs in the <strong>Start/End Frame</strong> creation mode.</p>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="step reveal">
          <figure class="step-media">
            <span class="chrome" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i><b>hailuoai.video/create/image-to-video</b><span class="chrome-tag"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="badge-check" class="lucide lucide-badge-check"><path d="M3.85 8.62a4 4 0 0 1 4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 6.74 0 4 4 0 0 1 4.78 4.78 4 4 0 0 1 0 6.74 4 4 0 0 1-4.77 4.78 4 4 0 0 1-6.75 0 4 4 0 0 1-4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 0-6.76Z"></path><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"></path></svg>Real Hailuo AI editor</span></span>
            <span class="shot">
              <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Hailuo AI model picker with the Hailuo 2.3 row selected, showing 768P-1080P and 6s-10s capability tags" width="736" height="460" loading="lazy" decoding="async">
            </span>
          </figure>
          <div class="step-body">
            <div class="step-head"><span class="step-dot" aria-hidden="true">2</span><h3>Select the Hailuo 2.3 Model</h3></div>
            <p>Switch the creation mode to <strong>Start/End Frame</strong>, then choose <strong>Hailuo 2.3</strong> (768P-1080P, 6s-10s) — or <strong>Hailuo 2.3-Fast</strong> when you want faster I2V iteration.</p>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="step reveal">
          <figure class="step-media">
            <span class="chrome" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i><b>hailuoai.video/create/image-to-video</b><span class="chrome-tag"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="badge-check" class="lucide lucide-badge-check"><path d="M3.85 8.62a4 4 0 0 1 4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 6.74 0 4 4 0 0 1 4.78 4.78 4 4 0 0 1 0 6.74 4 4 0 0 1-4.77 4.78 4 4 0 0 1-6.75 0 4 4 0 0 1-4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 0-6.76Z"></path><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"></path></svg>Real Hailuo AI editor</span></span>
            <span class="shot">
              <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Hailuo AI Create button showing the 25-credit cost for a Hailuo 2.3 generation at 768p 6 seconds" width="688" height="430" loading="lazy" decoding="async">
            </span>
          </figure>
          <div class="step-body">
            <div class="step-head"><span class="step-dot" aria-hidden="true">3</span><h3>Generate &amp; Refine</h3></div>
            <p>Click <strong>Create</strong> — the entry 768p 6s spec costs <strong>25 credits</strong>. Review the result, then adjust your prompt to improve motion, style, or camera feeling and try again.</p>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="step reveal">
          <figure class="step-media">
            <span class="chrome" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i><b>hailuoai.video/create/image-to-video</b><span class="chrome-tag"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="badge-check" class="lucide lucide-badge-check"><path d="M3.85 8.62a4 4 0 0 1 4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 6.74 0 4 4 0 0 1 4.78 4.78 4 4 0 0 1 0 6.74 4 4 0 0 1-4.77 4.78 4 4 0 0 1-6.75 0 4 4 0 0 1-4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 0-6.76Z"></path><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"></path></svg>Real Hailuo AI editor</span></span>
            <span class="shot">
              <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="A finished Hailuo 2.3 video in the project view with Recreate, Download All, and More actions below the player" width="688" height="430" loading="lazy" decoding="async">
            </span>
          </figure>
          <div class="step-body">
            <div class="step-head"><span class="step-dot" aria-hidden="true">4</span><h3>Export &amp; Launch</h3></div>
            <p>Download your video in <strong>HD resolution</strong>. Direct export options allow you to immediately post to TikTok, Instagram, or your ad manager.</p>
          </div>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section id="faq" aria-labelledby="faq-title">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="section-head reveal">
        <h2 id="faq-title">Frequently Asked Questions</h2>
        <p>What creators ask about the Hailuo 2.3 model — capabilities, the Fast variant, free trials, and credit costs.</p>
      </div>
      <p class="faq-kicker reveal"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="box" class="lucide lucide-box"><path d="M21 8a2 2 0 0 0-1-1.73l-7-4a2 2 0 0 0-2 0l-7 4A2 2 0 0 0 3 8v8a2 2 0 0 0 1 1.73l7 4a2 2 0 0 0 2 0l7-4A2 2 0 0 0 21 16Z"></path><path d="m3.3 7 8.7 5 8.7-5"></path><path d="M12 22V12"></path></svg>Model &amp; Capabilities</p>
      <div class="faq-list">
        <details class="faq-item reveal" open>
          <summary>What is the Hailuo 2.3 model?<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></summary>
          <div class="faq-body"><p>The <strong>Hailuo 2.3 model</strong> is a pro-tier AI video generation model that supports both <strong>Text-to-Video (T2V)</strong> and <strong>Image-to-Video (I2V)</strong>. It focuses on smoother motion, stronger style stability, and more lifelike facial emotion.</p></div>
        </details>
        <details class="faq-item reveal">
          <summary>What's improved in Hailuo 2.3 compared to earlier versions?<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></summary>
          <div class="faq-body"><p>Key improvements include better stability for anime/special styles, stronger performance on complex full-body motion (like dance), more realistic facial micro-expressions, and more reliable results for commercial/product scenes.</p></div>
        </details>
        <details class="faq-item reveal">
          <summary>What's the difference between Hailuo 2.3 and Hailuo 2.3-Fast?<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></summary>
          <div class="faq-body"><p><strong>Hailuo 2.3</strong> supports both T2V and I2V. <strong>Hailuo 2.3-Fast</strong> is optimized for speed and cost and currently focuses on <strong>I2V</strong> workflows — great for rapid iteration and testing.</p></div>
        </details>
        <details class="faq-item reveal">
          <summary>Does the Hailuo 2.3 series support first-and-last frame video generation?<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></summary>
          <div class="faq-body"><p>Not at the moment. The current Hailuo 2.3 series generates video from <strong>a single first frame</strong> (for I2V). Other capabilities such as camera movement follow the existing Hailuo workflow.</p></div>
        </details>
      </div>
      <p class="faq-kicker reveal"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="badge-dollar-sign" class="lucide lucide-badge-dollar-sign"><path d="M3.85 8.62a4 4 0 0 1 4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 6.74 0 4 4 0 0 1 4.78 4.78 4 4 0 0 1 0 6.74 4 4 0 0 1-4.77 4.78 4 4 0 0 1-6.75 0 4 4 0 0 1-4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 0-6.76Z"></path><path d="M16 8h-6a2 2 0 1 0 0 4h4a2 2 0 1 1 0 4H8"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path></svg>Pricing &amp; Access</p>
      <div class="faq-list">
        <details class="faq-item reveal">
          <summary>Can I try the Hailuo 2.3 model for free?<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></summary>
          <div class="faq-body"><p>During launch periods, HailuoAI may provide <strong>daily free trial credits</strong> for the Hailuo 2.3 model. These credits typically refresh each day and don't accumulate.</p></div>
        </details>
        <details class="faq-item reveal">
          <summary>What video specs and credit costs are available for Hailuo 2.3?<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></summary>
          <div class="faq-body"><p>Hailuo 2.3 supports multiple specs with different credit costs. Example options include <strong>768p 6s (25 credits)</strong>, <strong>768p 10s (50 credits)</strong>, and <strong>1080p 6s (50 credits)</strong>. Exact availability and pricing can vary by plan.</p></div>
        </details>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-more reveal">
        <span>Still have questions?</span>
